issues.title: Ambiguous <module> Placeholder
issues.why: The build script uses '<module>/constants.RepoPath' as an ldflag. A mediocre coder won't know if this should be the Go module name from go.mod or a literal string.
issues.fix: Explicitly state that '<module>' must be replaced with the actual Go module path found in the project's go.mod file.
